snippet.title: Go North - Official Demo Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Wander a world filled with cleverly-crafted mazes. Whoever can solve them all gets their wish granted by the Maze God. Explore beautiful mazes, discover unique items and help other maze explorers complete unusual side quests. Watch the Go North trailer for this upcoming cozy maze adventure to see gameplay and the colorful world. Go North will be available on PC and Mac, and a demo is out now on Steam.
